name: Paul
note: The apostle, a prisoner for Christ, whose name is on the letter.

name: Tychicus
note: A beloved brother and faithful servant who carried the letter and brought news (6:21-22).

name: The Gentile believers
note: Non-Jews who were once "far off" and have been brought near (2:11-13).

name: The Jewish believers
note: Those who were "first to hope in Christ" (1:12), now one body with the Gentiles.

name: The rulers and powers
note: The spiritual forces opposed to God that the letter says are under Christ's feet and that believers stand against (1:21; 6:12).

name: Jesus
note: The Christ, head of the church, in whom God unites all things.
